USDY is a tokenized, yield-bearing token issued by Ondo Finance. USDY is backed by short-term US Treasury assets. USDY is designed to accrue yield for its holders.

Aptos is a layer-1 public blockchain. Aptos uses the Move programming language for smart contracts. Aptos uses a proof-of-stake consensus mechanism.

The DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization built on the Ethereum blockchain. The DAO was governed by holders of its tokens. The DAO was launched in 2016 and was drained by an exploit in June 2016.

OUSG is a tokenized share of a short-term US government bond fund issued by Ondo Finance. OUSG provides exposure to US Treasury securities on a public blockchain.

Anchor is a lending protocol built on the Terra blockchain. Anchor offered deposit yields paid in UST, the Terra stablecoin. Anchor ceased to function after the collapse of the Terra ecosystem in May 2022.
